releases.notes:
Villagers Remember now speaks German, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian, as well as English and Bulgarian.

Twelve files, as in 0.13.3-beta. The name of each says the loader and the Minecraft version, for example `villagers-remember-paper-1.21.11-0.14.0-beta.jar`, so take the one that matches your server:
- Fabric, with Fabric API: `villagers-remember-fabric-<minecraft>-0.14.0-beta.jar`
- NeoForge: `villagers-remember-neoforge-<minecraft>-0.14.0-beta.jar`
- Paper, in the `plugins` folder: `villagers-remember-paper-<minecraft>-0.14.0-beta.jar`

Also new:
- Each player sees the mod in their own game language: dialogs, quests, chat lines, the sidebar, advancements and the settings screen. It works with a vanilla client too, because the server picks the text for each player.
- Mexican Spanish, Portuguese from Portugal and other close languages get the nearest one. Villager and village names stay the same in every language.
- The Tasks and Trade buttons in the greeting are a bit wider, so longer words fit.
- Maur0 ([Mauro0805](https://github.com/Mauro0805)) checked the Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.

Remove the old jar when you update. Your errands and standing stay as they are.

Questions, bugs, or a line that reads oddly in your language? Come to [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/X6yxJpk9Fz).

releases.notes:
Villagers Remember now runs on Minecraft 26.2, 26.1.2 and 1.21.11 as well as 26.3, on Fabric, NeoForge and Paper.

That makes twelve files. The name of each says the loader and the Minecraft version, for example `villagers-remember-paper-1.21.11-0.13.3-beta.jar`, so take the one that matches your server:
- Fabric, with Fabric API: `villagers-remember-fabric-<minecraft>-0.13.3-beta.jar`
- NeoForge: `villagers-remember-neoforge-<minecraft>-0.13.3-beta.jar`
- Paper, in the `plugins` folder: `villagers-remember-paper-<minecraft>-0.13.3-beta.jar`

Also new:
- Admins see a line when they join if a newer version is out, and everyone gets the Discord link. Both can be turned off in the settings (`updateCheck`, `supportMessage`).
- On 1.21.11, village waystones from the Waystones mod get the village's name too. Waystones 21.11.9 drops a name another mod sets, so the mod sets it again after the first activation.
- If you later upgrade a world from 1.21.11 to 26.x, the villagers keep what they remember.

Remove the old jar when you update. Your errands and standing stay as they are.

Questions or bugs? Come to [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/X6yxJpk9Fz).

releases.notes:
A fix for the librarian's enchanting errands. "Enchant 4 items at level 10 or higher" (and the level 30 one) never moved, because the mod compared the level with what the enchant cost, 1 to 3 levels, instead of the level shown on the option you picked. Now an option of level 10 or more counts and a lower one doesn't, on Fabric, NeoForge and Paper.

Three files, take the one for your server:
- `villagers-remember-fabric-0.13.2-beta.jar` for Fabric (needs Fabric API)
- `villagers-remember-neoforge-0.13.2-beta.jar` for NeoForge
- `villagers-remember-paper-0.13.2-beta.jar` for Paper, in the `plugins` folder

Remove the 0.13.1-beta jar when you update. Your errands and standing stay as they are.

Questions or bugs? Come to [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/X6yxJpk9Fz).

releases.notes:
Villagers Remember now runs on Paper 26.3 too, as a plugin. Players still join with a vanilla client.

Three files, take the one for your server:
- `villagers-remember-fabric-0.13.1-beta.jar` for Fabric (needs Fabric API)
- `villagers-remember-neoforge-0.13.1-beta.jar` for NeoForge
- `villagers-remember-paper-0.13.1-beta.jar` for Paper, in the `plugins` folder

Since 0.13.0-beta:
- New Paper version with the same errands and prices as the mod. Paper has no settings screen, so admins edit `plugins/VillagersRemember/villagersremember.json` and run `/errands reload`.
- Shift-clicking stonecutter results now counts for errands like Make Stone Bricks. Before, only single clicks counted.

The Fabric jar's name now starts with `villagers-remember-fabric`, so remove the old `villagers-remember-0.13.0-beta.jar` when you update.

Questions or bugs? Come to [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/X6yxJpk9Fz).

releases.notes:
First public beta for Minecraft 26.3. The mod runs on the server, and players join with a vanilla client.

Two files, same features: `villagers-remember-0.13.0-beta.jar` for Fabric (needs Fabric API) and `villagers-remember-neoforge-0.13.0-beta.jar` for NeoForge.

- Every villager with a job asks for help, and the village bell shows all of the village's errands. There are 21 kinds of tasks, like baking bread or finding a shipwreck.
- Villagers remember you. Your standing grows with each villager and each village, and prices follow it: up to 40% off for friends, up to 50% more if you hurt the village.
- In a new village one villager talks to you first. More open up as you help them, trade with them or raise the village's standing.
- Errands pay experience and standing. Server owners can turn emerald rewards on with `/errands emeralds on`. Items come once, from trials of trust and from each profession's top reward.
- Villages that trust you set emeralds aside in a treasury, and you collect them in your ender chest.
- For the long run there are weekly contracts, legendary items, monthly village orders for the whole server, fame titles and one patron per village.
- The mod has its own advancement tab and a chronicle book. Clients with the mod get a settings screen, where admins can chnage the server's settings.
- Works with Waystones (BlayTheNinth's mod or KawaMood's datapack): village waystones take the name of their village.
- English and Bulgarian.

Questions or bugs? Come to [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/X6yxJpk9Fz).
